ev.q: the Zambian Ministry of Health and CDC assessed the relationship between HIV infection and severe COVID-19
Among 443 patients included in the study, 122 (28%) were HIV-positive
Mixed-effects Cox proportional hazards regression models were used to examine time to COVID-19–associated death
91 (89%) were receiving ART at the time of hospitalization
among HIV-positive persons, those with severe HIV disease were more likely to develop severe COVID-19
However, among HIV-infected patients, compared with patients with controlled HIV, severe HIV disease was associated with severe COVID-19 at admission
Patient demographic, clinical, and survival time data were collected during hospitalization until patients died or were discharged.

methods_quotes.q: Mixed-effects logistic regression models were used to assess associations between exposure variables
Mixed-effects Cox proportional hazards regression models were used to examine time to COVID-19–associated death
An alpha level of 0.05 was used to assess statistical significance.
Comparison of proportions was via chi-square test, comparison of normally distributed variables was via Welch’s two sample t-test
Cox proportional hazards models were used for COVID-19–associated death outcome.
